scenario.title: Work ownership and shared resource coordination
situations: Several sessions need one shared mutable resource.
A process/coordination hold survives a session and blocks progress.
A resource must be handed to another holder without discarding active work.
scenario.current: Research trace; requirements and source paths need live proof.
questions: Audit which coordination keys are product procedures versus maintainer-specific locks.
Verify orphan/operator-release authority from current help/state; do not teach blanket cleanup from claim age alone.

lessons.title: Distinguish ownership from resource coordination
lessons.when: When concurrent work needs a declared shared resource or a holder conflict appears.
lessons.need: Identify whether the hold owns an item, steering scope, process or resource; preserve the real owner and use the declared handoff/release path.
lessons.gap: Existing map traces path overlaps and steering, but not every non-path coordination scenario. Review question: should JOURNEYS show resource-busy recovery as a branch rather than teaching all claims during installation?
